build_autoencoder_layers: build encoder and decoder layers for an autoencoder with configurable feature maps and skip connections
create_autoencoder_model: create an AutoEncoder model that encodes images and decodes them conditioned on attribute vectors
create_latent_discriminator: create a LatentDiscriminator that classifies latent representations into attribute categories using conv and linear layers
create_patch_discriminator: create a PatchDiscriminator that evaluates image patches and returns per-sample real/fake scores via sigmoid
flip_attributes: flip one or all attribute values in a batch of attribute tensors using the params mapping
